## [I received a broken dresser over a…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/653a8d068960241eb4d3ba03)
I received a broken dresser over a month ago and I still haven’t received support from someone to come fix it. Metro has lost my notes 3 different times now so I just continue to have to repeat my situation. In the meantime, my dresser continues to get slightly damaged and I paid over $3000 for this. I am so disappointed by how awful this experience has been and that there isn’t better service for such high ticket items.

September 4, 2023
